breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt was contradictory because it asked to use the exact formula for polar moment of inertia (J) while also instructing to model the shaft as a thin-walled tube using a different approximation. The ground truth resolves this by removing the instruction for the thin-walled tube approximation. The generated specification, however, kept both contradictory methods, explicitly stating to model it as a thin-walled tube while also providing formulas for the exact method and the angle of twist using the exact 'J'. This repeats the original error instead of correcting it.
